media.title: St. Alexander’s Church, Warsaw — photochrom, 1890–1905
media.description: Historical context image of St. Alexander’s Church on Three Crosses Square in Warsaw, connected here with the parish context of Bronisław Kaper’s 1920 baptismal record. The image is a Library of Congress photochrom view, dated between 1890 and 1905, accessed through Wikimedia Commons / SRC0456.
media.altText: Photochrom view of St. Alexander’s Church on Three Crosses Square in Warsaw, dated between 1890 and 1905.
